items.title: Helen Oakley Dance interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: And Jess and George Wettling, and Paul Mares. And so I wanted to record them. They were at the — gee I don’t know the title of the place, it was a famous place, a New Orleans spot, where they played. And so I did that.

ctx.x: Yeah. It’s a wonderful thing. So I went to Chicago, and I wanted to record the guys, Jess for instance. I’d never recorded before. Nobody knew about Jess. Stacy, you know. And Jess and George Wettling, and Paul Mares. And so I wanted to record them. They were at the — gee I don’t know the title of the place, it was a famous place, a New Orleans spot, where they played. And so I did that. I think it was The Brunswick. But actually the Brunswick studios were kaput after a while, because the elevated ran right there.
